channels.description:
How did families keep a house cool without electricity, make food last with no refrigerator, and live without endless energy bills? I'm Robert — and I still remember the old ways they used to.

I grew up around people who knew how to live without depending on the systems modern families now take for granted. We kept our homes warm and cool without the power company, preserved our own food, built things to last, and wasted almost nothing — the old-fashioned, self-sufficient way of living that most people forgot in a single generation.

On this channel I share those forgotten household methods and old-fashioned skills: off-grid style cooling and heating, gardening and food preservation, natural pest control, frugal living, and simple traditional tricks people used every day just a few generations ago — the ones nobody passes down anymore.

No miracle cures. No "banned" secrets. Just real, low-cost, old-fashioned methods that worked then and still work now.

I've pulled hundred-year-old equipment out of barns that still worked. Somebody knew something.

I'm Otis. I'm sixty-four. I spent forty years picking barns and estate auctions across the Midwest, and I grew up on a hundred and sixty acres outside Cedar Rapids, Iowa. Everything on this channel is what farmers did when there was no power in the barn, no store for twenty miles, and no money for either — and why most of it still beats what they sell you now.

Fence posts that outlive the man who set them. Bugs out of the grain without a drop of spray. Barns that stayed dry a century without a sealant. Tools with the original handles. All of it for a few dollars or nothing, done the barn way.

And I'll be straight with you every time: what works, what doesn't, what's against the law now, and where the old-timers had the right rule for the wrong reason. I'd rather be useful than romantic.

New video every day. I read every comment.
